faqs.question: Can the printer still print if an ink cartridge is expended or not installed?
faqs.answer: No. The printer will not operate if any cartridge is expended or removed. It's best to always have extra cartridges on hand.

faqs.question: I am unable to connect my product to a wireless network. What should I do?
faqs.answer: The printer does not come with built-in wireless features and does not support a wireless (or Ethernet) connection to a network router. Only a direct wired connection to the computer is supported.

faqs.question: When I try to print to my product in Windows 7, printing is slow or my product stops printing. What should I do?
faqs.answer:
Try the following:
Select a lower quality setting in the printer software.
Make sure your system meets the minimum system requirements for your printer.
Close the
Devices and Printers
window before you print.
Clear space on your hard drive or run a defragmentation utility.
Close programs that you're not using.
Increase your system's memory.

faqs.question: Can the Epson ink cartridges be refilled or can I use third-party ink cartridges without voiding the warranty?
faqs.answer:
Epson does not recommend refilling or using other brands of ink cartridges.  Epson uses a permanent Micro Piezo print head that has allowed Epson to lead the industry in delivering consistent photo image quality by using variable-sized droplets.  Micro Piezo print head can also use a wider variety of inks, which has allowed Epson to introduce such ink breakthroughs as DURABrite® and Epson UltraChrome® inks that offer greatly improved humidity resistance, smudge resistance, and fade resistance.
Using refilled ink cartridges will not void the product's original warranty; however, if these products cause a failure, the repair of that failure will not be covered under warranty.

faqs.question: I brought my product with me to a different country and can't find ink for it. What should I do?
faqs.answer:
Some Epson printers and ink cartridges are specific to a regional market and not sold worldwide, although the same printers are sold in the U.S. and Canada. If you have a printer sold in the U.S. or Canada, you may not be able to easily get ink cartridges for it in foreign markets.
Unfortunately, because of customs and tax regulations, the Epson E-Stores in the U.S. and Canada are unable to ship to addresses outside the U.S. and Canada.

faqs.question: Can I use hole-punched paper with my product?
faqs.answer: No. The product does not support this paper type.

faqs.question: Does OS X support manual duplex printing with my product?
faqs.answer: This feature is not supported in Mac OS X. However, if your printer has a built-in automatic duplexer, auto-duplexing is supported in Mac OS X 10.6 (Snow Leopard).

faqs.question: I can't scan multiple document pages into a single PDF. What should I do?
faqs.answer: If you are using the Scanner Driver and Epson Scan Utility v2.92a or earlier, the ability to scan multiple pages to a single PDF is not supported. This feature is supported when using the Scanner Driver (which is sometimes shown as TWAIN Driver) and Epson Scan Utility v3.04a or higher. Check your product's Downloads tab to make sure you're using the latest version.

faqs.question: Does Epson have a program where I can donate my working electronic equipment?
faqs.answer:
Yes. Epson America, Inc. and
Digitunity
have joined together with the goal of helping those who are facing economic challenges or have a disability to gain access to today's technology. With your donation, you not only help the environment, but you also help change the lives of those who need these products the most.

faqs.question: Do I need a filter if I'm faxing over a DSL?
faqs.answer: Yes, you must connect the appropriate DSL filter or ISDN terminal adapter or router to the wall jack to use the line for faxing or voice calls on your product. Contact your DSL or ISDN provider for the necessary equipment.

faqs.question: Can I print on transparencies?
faqs.answer:
Yes. Epson cannot guarantee the print quality on transparencies, but for best results select
Plain Paper/Bright White Paper
as the
Type
(Windows) or
Media Type
(Macintosh) setting in your printer software.

faqs.question: When I try to print to my product in Windows 7, printing is slow or my product stops printing. What should I do?
faqs.answer:
Try the following:
Select a lower quality setting in the printer software.
Make sure your system meets the minimum system requirements for your printer.
Close the
Devices and Printers
window before you print.
Clear space on your hard drive or run a defragmentation utility.
Close programs that you're not using.
Increase your system's memory.

faqs.question: Does OS X support manual duplex printing with my product?
faqs.answer: This feature is not supported in Mac OS X. However, if your printer has a built-in automatic duplexer, auto-duplexing is supported in Mac OS X 10.6 (Snow Leopard).

faqs.question: It takes a long time to copy a document. What should I do?
faqs.answer:
Try the following:
Select
B&W
as the copy type.
Select
With Border
as the layout type.*
Make sure
2-Sided Printing
is turned off.*
Select
Plain Paper
as the paper type.
Select
Draft
or
Standard
as the quality type.
Make sure
Dry Time
is set to
Standard
.*
* This step may not apply to your all-in-one.

faqs.question: I see the message Scanner Not Ready or Epson Scan will not start in Windows or on my Mac. What should I do?
faqs.answer:
Try the following:
Make sure your product is turned on and securely connected to your computer or USB hub.
If your product is connected to a USB hub, make sure it's connected to a first tier hub (the hub closest to the computer) that has its own A/C adapter when more than one hub is connected to the computer.
Try restarting your computer.
Make sure Epson Scan is set up correctly for a USB connection. See the steps below:
Make sure the product is turned on.
Do one of the following:
Windows 8
: Navigate to the
Start
screen, right-click the screen, select
All apps
, then select
EPSON Scan Settings
.
Windows (other versions)
: Click
Start
or
, and select
Programs
or
All Programs
. Select
EPSON Scan
>
EPSON Scan Settings
(or
EPSON
, then
EPSON Scan
, and then
EPSON Scan Settings
.)
Mac
: Search for
EPSON Scan Settings
, then click
EPSON Scan Settings
to open it.
If you see the screen below, click
No
. The screen may appear twice.
Make sure the correct scanner is selected.
Make sure the
Connection
setting is set to
Local
.
If the steps above do not help, try the following.
Windows 7 and Windows Vista
:
Turn off the printer.
Uninstall Epson Scan.
Restart your computer.
Open Windows Explorer (right-click
, then select
Explore
or
Open Windows Explorer
).
Navigate to
C:\Windows
Locate the
twain_32
folder and rename it to a different name such as
twain_32_old
.
Restart your computer.
Reinstall Epson Scan.
Windows (other versions)
or
Mac
: Uninstall and reinstall the Epson Scan software.

faqs.question: I see the message Cannot connect to Internet in Windows 8.1 after I select Driver Update in my product software. What should I do?
faqs.answer:
The
Driver Update
option does not work in Windows 8.1. All other driver options will work correctly.

faqs.question: Can I use a pre-paid calling card to send a fax?
faqs.answer:
Yes. Do the following:
Connect an external phone to the printer.
Use the attached phone to dial the number and password on the pre-paid calling card, then dial the destination fax number.
When the destination fax number answers, press the
Start
button to send the fax.

faqs.question: I'm having trouble sending or receiving faxes over a VoIP (Voice over Internet Protocol) phone line. Why?
faqs.answer:
Because fax machines are designed to work over standard analog telephone lines, Epson does not guarantee that fax transmission will work over VoIP phone lines (cable systems such as Cox, Charter, Time Warner, Comcast, FiOS, magicJack, and Vonage).
Internet traffic can interfere with faxing because VoIP communicates through the internet and not through standard analog telephone line. The data sent over the internet for a fax is digitized into packets and this process can cause data loss.
You can try slowing the transmission speed of the fax by setting ECM and V.34 on the all-in-one to
Off
. See
Selecting Fax Settings
for instructions.
If this does not help, contact your VoIP service provider for help.

faqs.question: Will I lose faxes stored in the fax memory if the product is turned off?
faqs.answer: Yes, all faxes held in memory will be erased if the all-in-one is turned off.

faqs.question: How do I confirm my fax was sent?
faqs.answer:
You can print a fax report to confirm the fax was sent. See
Selecting Fax Settings
.

faqs.question: Will my fax still go through if I receive an ink expended or other error during transmission?
faqs.answer: Yes, the fax will still go through unless the all-in-one is turned off.

faqs.question: How do I add a delay when I fax to an International number?
faqs.answer:
Press
Redial/Pause
on the product's control panel to insert a 3 second delay within a phone number. The delay will appear as a − (minus) symbol on product's display. For a longer delay, insert the − symbol multiple times.
Note:
You can't add a delay at the beginning of a phone number.

faqs.question: I'm having trouble sending or receiving faxes. What should I do?
faqs.answer:
Try the following:
Make sure the printer's
LINE
port is connected to a telephone wall jack.
Verify that the telephone wall jack works by connecting a phone to it. If the line has static, turn off the
V.34 and ECM (Error Correction Mode) settings
.
If the all-in-one is connected to a DSL phone line, a DSL filter must be connected to the phone jack. Contact your DSL provider for the necessary filter.
If you answer the phone and hear a fax tone and the call disconnects when you hang up, make sure there is a
phone or answering machine connected
to the
EXT.
port on the all-in-one.
Make sure that your recipient's fax machine is turned on and working.
Make sure
paper is loaded correctly
.
If you're using
DRD
(Distinctive Ring Detection), try setting
DRD
to
OFF
or
ALL
. If the fax answers when turning off
DRD
, the ring pattern may be causing the problem. Contact your phone company.
If a telephone with an answering machine is connected to the all-in-one and you would like to set the all-in-one to automatically receive and print faxes,
set the number of rings
on the all-in-one to more than the answering machine, and turn
Auto Answer
mode on (on the all-in-one).
Turn call waiting off. Call waiting may disrupt an incoming or outgoing fax.
If the all-in-one does not receive a fax, verify that it's not connected to a PBX system. The ring signal on a PBX system can cause a problem. Contact your PBX administrator for support.
Note:
Because fax machines are designed to work over standard analog telephone lines, Epson does not guarantee that fax transmission will work over VOIP phone lines (cable systems such as Cox, Charter, Time Warner, Comcast, FIOS, Vonage).

faqs.question: How do I use an answering machine with my fax?
faqs.answer:
Do the following:
Make sure that your answering machine is connected to the EXT port on the Epson fax machine.
Set the number of rings on the answering machine.
Set the number of rings on the fax machine to a number greater than the answering machine (for example, if answering machine is set to 4, the fax must be set for 5 or more).
Ensure that the answering machine is set to answer and the fax machine is set to Auto Answer.
When the answering machine picks up a fax call, the fax machine listens on the line and if it detects the fax tones, it takes over the call and disconnects the answering machine.

faqs.question: How do I change the baud rate on my fax?
faqs.answer:
There is no specific Baud Rate selection on the fax machine.  You can change the V.34 setting to OFF to slow down the Baud Rate to 14.4k.  See
Selecting Fax Settings
.

faqs.question: Can I create a speed dial list for my fax numbers?
faqs.answer:
Yes. See
Setting Up Your Speed Dial List
.

faqs.question: How do I send a fax?
faqs.answer:
See
Sending a Fax
.

faqs.question: When I try to send a fax, I see the message Fax not sent. Resend using the Start B&W button. Why?
faqs.answer:
You sent a fax using the
Start Color
button to a fax machine that prints only in black and white. Send the fax again, but press the
Start B&W
button.
You can also select to send faxes only in black and white. See
Selecting Fax Settings
for details.

faqs.question: How do I create a header for my faxes?
faqs.answer:
See
Creating Header Information
.

faqs.question: I can't receive a fax, even though I can send a fax with no problem. What should I do?
faqs.answer:
Change the
V.34
and
ECM
communication fax settings to
Off
. See
Selecting Fax Settings
.

faqs.question: Do I need to use a filter if I fax over a VoIP (Voice over Internet Protocol) line?
faqs.answer:
No, the filters are only required if you have DSL service.
Because fax machines are designed to work over standard analog telephone lines, Epson does not guarantee that fax transmission will work over VoIP phone lines (cable systems such as Cox, Charter, Time Warner, Comcast, FiOS, magicJack, and Vonage).
Internet traffic can interfere with faxing because VoIP communicates through the internet and not through standard analog telephone lines. The data sent over the internet for a fax is digitized into packets and this process can cause data loss.
You can try slowing the transmission speed of the fax by setting ECM on the product to
Off
and selecting a slower Fax Speed. If this does not help, contact your VoIP service provider for help.
For more information, please contact your telephone service provider.

faqs.question: Can I use digital voicemail with my fax?
faqs.answer:
If your digital voicemail is provided by your phone company and is not a separate answering machine, you cannot use the product to automatically receive and print faxes. To receive faxes manually, turn off Auto Answer mode. Epson recommends that you use a separate answering machine connected to the
EXT
port on the product for best results.

faqs.question: Do I need a filter if I'm faxing over a DSL?
faqs.answer: Yes, you must connect the appropriate DSL filter or ISDN terminal adapter or router to the wall jack to use the line for faxing or voice calls on your product. Contact your DSL or ISDN provider for the necessary equipment.

faqs.question: A color ink cartridge is expended even though I print in black only. Why does this happen?
faqs.answer:
To keep the print head clear and ready to print, the printer uses a small amount of ink from all the cartridges whenever it prints.   Even if you select
Black ink Only
, some color ink is still being used.

Cyan

faqs.question: How long should an ink cartridge remain in my product if it's not used often?
faqs.answer: When an installed ink cartridge is more than six months old, you may need to replace it if you notice that your printouts don't look as good as they used to and quality doesn't improve after cleaning and aligning the print head.

faqs.question: How do I change the ink cartridges?
faqs.answer:
See
Replacing an Ink Cartridge
.

faqs.question: How can I check to see how much ink is left?
faqs.answer:
You can
check the ink supply from your computer
or
check the ink supply from the CX5800F's control panel
.

faqs.question: Can the Epson ink cartridges be refilled or can I use third-party ink cartridges without voiding the warranty?
faqs.answer:
Epson does not recommend refilling or using other brands of ink cartridges.  Epson uses a permanent Micro Piezo print head that has allowed Epson to lead the industry in delivering consistent photo image quality by using variable-sized droplets.  Micro Piezo print head can also use a wider variety of inks, which has allowed Epson to introduce such ink breakthroughs as DURABrite® and Epson UltraChrome® inks that offer greatly improved humidity resistance, smudge resistance, and fade resistance.
Using refilled ink cartridges will not void the product's original warranty; however, if these products cause a failure, the repair of that failure will not be covered under warranty.

faqs.question: Can the printer still print if an ink cartridge is expended or not installed?
faqs.answer: No. The printer will not operate if any cartridge is expended or removed. It's best to always have extra cartridges on hand.

faqs.question: I brought my product with me to a different country and can't find ink for it. What should I do?
faqs.answer:
Some Epson printers and ink cartridges are specific to a regional market and not sold worldwide, although the same printers are sold in the U.S. and Canada. If you have a printer sold in the U.S. or Canada, you may not be able to easily get ink cartridges for it in foreign markets.
Unfortunately, because of customs and tax regulations, the Epson E-Stores in the U.S. and Canada are unable to ship to addresses outside the U.S. and Canada.

faqs.question: Can I use sheet labels with my product?
faqs.answer:
You can use Epson's
Photo Quality Self Adhesive Sheets
. A cutting grid is printed on the reverse side of each sheet for easy custom trimming (such as labels). To avoid paper jams, load only one sheet at a time. Also, set the
Type
or
Media Type
setting in the driver to
Matte Paper - Heavyweight
.

faqs.question: Does the type of paper I use really make a difference?
faqs.answer:
The type of paper you choose affects the way your printout looks, so be sure to select the correct media for your job. If you are just making a copy or printing a rough draft of an image, plain paper is fine. However, for the best results, you'll want to use one of Epson's special ink jet papers designed for your printer. For example, your photos will look great printed on
Epson Premium Glossy Photo Paper
. See
Special Papers
.

faqs.question: I'm having paper feed problems. What should I do?
faqs.answer:
See
Paper Feeding Problems
.

faqs.question: Can I use hole-punched paper with my product?
faqs.answer: No. The product does not support this paper type.

faqs.question: When I print, my product cuts off some of the characters on the right side of the page. What should I do?
faqs.answer:
In some older applications you can resolve character clipping by enabling fractional character widths.  Do the following:
AppleWorks:
Open your document.
Click
Edit
, then
Preferences
.
Topic should be set to
Text
.
Below Options, check
Fractional Character Widths
.
Click
OK
to print the document.
When the file is saved, the setting will be saved with it.
Microsoft Word 98
Open your document.
Click
Tools
, then
Preferences
.
Click the Print tab.
Below options for current document only, select
Fractional Widths
.
Click
OK
to print the document.
When the file is saved, the setting will be saved with it.
WordPerfect
Click
File
then
Page Setup
.
Below Options, make sure Fractional Character Widths is
ON
.
When other Macintosh programs are affected, you can also try to disable
Smooth all fonts on screen
.
Click
Apple
,
Control Panel
, then
Appearance
.
Click
Font
, then disable
Smooth all fonts on screen
.
Close Appearance then restart and try printing again.

faqs.question: My printout contains garbled characters when I print from my computer. What should I do?
faqs.answer:
If you see incorrect or garbled characters, the problem could be due to a cabling issue or software setting. See
Miscellaneous Printout Problems
.

faqs.question: The printout has a slight slant. What should I do?
faqs.answer: Make sure the original document is aligned with the edges of the scanner glass, but leave a 0.04 inch (1 mm) inch gap between the document and the top and side edges of the scanner glass.

faqs.question: My product is printing blank pages from Windows or my Mac. What should I do?
faqs.answer:
If pages are coming out blank, the problem could be due to a software setting or the CX5800F's condition. See
Miscellaneous Printout Problems
.

faqs.question: My printout is blurry or smeared. What should I do?
faqs.answer:
If your printout is blurry or smeared, the CX5800F may not be set up correctly or there may be a problem with the paper's condition. See
Print Quality Problems
.

faqs.question: My printout has incorrect or missing colors. What should I do?
faqs.answer:
If colors are incorrect or missing, the problem could be due to a software setting, the CX5800F's condition, or the paper you're using. See
Print Quality Problems
.
Your monitor and the CX5800F use different technologies to represent colors, so your printed colors can't match your screen colors exactly. You can also try increasing your monitor's color palette to view a greater range of colors.

faqs.question: My printout is grainy when I print from any application. What should I do?
faqs.answer:
If the printout is grainy, the problem could be due to a software setting or the CX5800F's condition or it could be paper related. See
Print Quality Problems
.

faqs.question: The quality of my printed output is unacceptable. What should I do?
faqs.answer:
See
Print Quality Problems
.

faqs.question: My printout has incorrect margins. What should I do?
faqs.answer:
If you're copying or printing, first make sure the paper is loaded correctly. See
Loading Paper
.
If you're copying using the buttons on the CX5800F, the problem could be related to either of the following:
Your document may not be aligned correctly. See
Placing the Original on the Glass
.
The type of paper you select and the
Fit to Page
option determine the size of the margins. See
Copying
.
If you're printing from your computer, the problem could be caused by a software setting. See
Miscellaneous Printout Problems
.
If you're printing from a web browser, the pages may not print correctly due to the web page design. Try one of the following:
Check to see if there is a
Printer Friendly Version
(or similarly named) icon or link on the web page that you can click on.
Experiment with page setup and paper size, then select
Print Preview
from the
File
menu in your application to view the changes.
If you're scanning, make sure you've aligned the document correctly. See
Placing Originals for Scanning
.

faqs.question: My printout has lines running through it. What should I do?
faqs.answer:
Try one or more of these solutions:
Run the Head Cleaning utility to clear any clogged ink nozzles. See
Cleaning the Print Head
.
Run the Print Head Alignment utility. See
Aligning the Print Head
.
Make sure the paper type setting you select is appropriate for the type of media you've loaded in the CX5800F.
Make sure that the printable side of the paper is face up in the sheet feeder.
If you're printing from a computer, clear the
High Speed
check box in the Advanced section of the driver settings.

faqs.question: Web pages don't print the way they appear on my monitor. What should I do?
faqs.answer:
The pages may not print correctly due to the web page design. Try the following:
Check for a
Printer-friendly Version
(or similarly named) option on the web page.
Change the page setup and paper size settings, and select the preview option in your browser to check the changes before you print.

faqs.question: The edges of my original do not scan. What should I do?
faqs.answer:
Make sure you've placed your document correctly on the scanner glass. See
Placing Originals for Scanning
.

faqs.question: I want to enlarge an image that I'm scanning with Epson Scan. How do I obtain the best quality?
faqs.answer:
To obtain the best quality, you should resize your image when you're scanning instead of enlarging it later in an image-editing program.
For specific instructions on resizing your image when you're scanning, see
Selecting the Scan Size
.
Note:
If you plan to enlarge your image later in an image-editing program, you need to increase the
Resolution
setting to retain a high image quality after enlargement. Increase the resolution by the same amount you will increase the image size. For example, if the resolution is 300 dpi (dots per inch), but you will increase the image size by 200% in an image-editing program, change the
Resolution
setting to 600 dpi in Epson Scan.

faqs.question: The quality of a scanned image with Epson Scan is poor. What should I do?
faqs.answer:
See
Scan Quality Problems
.

faqs.question: I am unable to scan from my computer. What should I do?
faqs.answer:
Try the following:
Make sure the CX5800F is turned on and securely connected to your computer or USB hub.
If the CX5800F is connected to a USB hub, make sure it's connected to a first tier hub (the hub closest to the host computer) when more than one hub is connected to the computer.
Try restarting your computer.
Make sure you installed all the software correctly. See
Install Software
.

faqs.question: How do I decide which resolution to select when scanning from Epson Scan?
faqs.answer:
See
Selecting the Scan Resolution
.

faqs.question: I'm having problems installing the software. What should I do?
faqs.answer:
Make sure you close all other applications, including any screen savers and/or anti-virus software programs, before you begin the installation.
You may need to uninstall the software, then reinstall the software.

faqs.question: I can't scan multiple document pages into a single PDF. What should I do?
faqs.answer: If you are using the Scanner Driver and Epson Scan Utility v2.92a or earlier, the ability to scan multiple pages to a single PDF is not supported. This feature is supported when using the Scanner Driver (which is sometimes shown as TWAIN Driver) and Epson Scan Utility v3.04a or higher. Check your product's Downloads tab to make sure you're using the latest version.

faqs.question: How do I change the font size of text when I print from software in Windows?
faqs.answer: You need to select the text or font size in the software you are printing from, not the printer driver. For detailed instructions, contact the company for the application you are printing from.

faqs.question: Does Epson make drivers for Linux?
faqs.answer:
Linux drivers are available for some products. Visit the links below to see the drivers available for your product, as well as information about using an Epson product with Linux.
Note:
Epson does not provide support for Linux drivers.
Linux drivers for Epson products
Linux FAQs for Epson products
(only available in English)
Linux manuals for Epson products
(only available in English)

faqs.question: I can't find some of my printer's settings in macOS 12 or later. What should I do?
faqs.answer:
Make sure you're using the Epson driver for your printer. See our
Adding a Printer in macOS 12 or Later
page for instructions.

faqs.question: How do I add my Epson printer to the Printer list in macOS 12 or later?
faqs.answer:
See our
Adding a Printer in macOS 12 or Later
page for details.

faqs.question: How do I install a printer in Windows 11 24H2 or later?
faqs.answer:
See our
Installing a Printer in Windows 11 24H2 or Later
page for details.

faqs.question: I am unable to connect my product to a wireless network. What should I do?
faqs.answer: The printer does not come with built-in wireless features and does not support a wireless (or Ethernet) connection to a network router. Only a direct wired connection to the computer is supported.

faqs.question: When printing in Windows, how can I prevent an extra page from being ejected after every print job?
faqs.answer:
The Separator Page function may be enabled. Follow these steps to disable it:
Click
Start
or
.
Do one of the following:
Windows XP
:
Select
Printers and Faxes
(or select
Settings
, then select
Printers and Faxes
).
Windows Vista
:
Select
Control Panel
, then
Printer
or
Printers
under Hardware and Sound
.
Windows 7
:
Select
Control Panel
, then
View Devices and Printers
under Hardware and Sound.
In the
Printers
or
Printers and Faxes
window, right-click on your printer's name.
Select
Properties
, click the Advanced tab, then press the
Separator Page
button.
In the Separator Page window, delete the information in the text box and then click
OK
.
Click
OK
again.

faqs.question: How should I transport my product?
faqs.answer:
See
Transporting the Epson Stylus CX5800F
.

faqs.question: Does Epson have a program where I can donate my working electronic equipment?
faqs.answer:
Yes. Epson America, Inc. and
Digitunity
have joined together with the goal of helping those who are facing economic challenges or have a disability to gain access to today's technology. With your donation, you not only help the environment, but you also help change the lives of those who need these products the most.

faqs.question: Where do I find my product's serial number?
faqs.answer:
See our
Finding Your Epson Product Serial Number
page for details.
